card.name: Second digit inside split numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the second or later digit of a number broken into pieces, such as the 0 in 40, the 7 in 370, or the 5 in 2.5. It appears in dose, time or radioactivity figures.

modes.label: Second digit of whole numbers
modes.description: The digit after the first digit of a two- or three-digit number before units like mcg, MBq, days or hours.

modes.label: Digit after a decimal point
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in a dose such as 2.5 mg.
